title: Phase — Test & compliance
description: Tests → (optional) light refactor once green → compliance. On failure: classify and return to Execute or Plan/Review.

steps.title: Run / add tests
steps.notes: Prefer tests close to user-visible behavior; gate: do not add more feature work while red. Summarize commands run, pass/fail, and key failures in **VERIFY-TESTS.md** (short — avoid pasting secrets or full PII). Also write **VERIFY-EVIDENCE.json** with machine-readable records (`command`, `exit_code`, `timestamp`, `commit_sha`, `evidence_path`).

on_failure.minor_bug: Return to Execute phase (phase.execute): fix, commit, re-run tests until green.
on_failure.wrong_requirement: Stop extending the wrong direction; update PLAN.md if needed and return to Review or Plan (phase.review / phase.plan) to reset scope.

steps.title: Light refactor before compliance (when tests are green)
steps.notes: Same skill as Execute step refactor_chunk (tidy-refactor) but different step context: chunk tidy vs one pass before verify_compliance. Skip if already clean. See PLAN-VERIFY-DELIVER-SKILL-REFACTOR.md §4.1.

steps.title: Compliance
steps.notes: verify_compliance with artifact + checklist. Pass = verify phase complete unless the parent workflow marks it optional. Record outcome and checklist id(s) in **VERIFY-COMPLIANCE.md** before approve (summary only).

on_failure.minor_bug: Return to Execute until checklist passes; re-run tests + compliance.
on_failure.wrong_requirement: If the checklist reflects a spec misunderstanding: return to Plan/Review instead of patching blindly.
